lines.item: Legacy Ethereum pool fee ETH actually collected this week
lines.check: filled (claimed out of the revenue vault)
lines.why: ProjectRevenue 0x49A91293a8dFf24d5c54b798C45376301D29b9f3 emits RevenueClaimed when ETH leaves it. In blocks 26,323,365-26,373,602 there are 5 claims, all to the founder admin wallet 0xBb14…f1c5, totalling 6.848892 ETH (blocks 26,329,343; 26,354,928; 26,358,459; 26,371,648; 26,371,721). A claim pays out whatever has accrued, so part of it may be fee earned before 2 Nov. For comparison, the fees recorded in the window: 2,932 TradeRecorded receipts (ids 6,604-9,535, no gaps) carry 9.120128 ETH in the fee field (2.3% of each trade's ETH leg) and 0.979415 ETH in the second field; under treasury-only module 0x19de (from 6 Nov 00:27 UTC) 1,748 receipts carry 2.122101 ETH and the second field is 0.

lines.item: Robinhood pool treasury share (0.9% of swaps, plus 0.1% advisor)
lines.check: filled (claimed on Robinhood Chain, in 3 stages)
lines.value: 1.162877 ETH claimed (treasury 1.123390 + advisor 0.039486); 0.018078 ETH allocated but unclaimed at window end (line B)
lines.why: Fee hook 0x15BB…BFff emits FeeAllocated(liquidity, treasury) on each swap and FeesClaimed(recipient, amount) on each payout. Robinhood blocks 103,783,392-109,623,864 (2-8 Nov UTC; first swap 6 Nov 00:11 UTC). Stage 1, 6 Nov 00:11-20:57 UTC (before the split switch, block 107,878,093): FeeAllocated treasury 0.000030 ETH, liquidity 2.549943 ETH; the liquidity vault 0x171F…9016 claimed 2.535650 ETH in 199 claims, matching the 6 Nov 'all to liquidity' post. Stage 2, 6 Nov 20:57 - 8 Nov 01:02 UTC (1% burn / 1% treasury, before the advisor config at block 108,837,938): treasury allocated 0.756707 ETH; 473 claims to the treasury (founder admin wallet 0xBb14…f1c5) = 0.756025 ETH. Stage 3, 8 Nov 01:02 UTC to window end (0.9% treasury / 0.1% advisor): treasury bucket allocated 0.424217 ETH; 130 claims to 0xBb14 = 0.367365 ETH and 62 claims to the advisor wallet 0x1C31…2853 = 0.039486 ETH (first 8 Nov 01:34 UTC). Totals: treasury 1.123390 ETH + advisor 0.039486 ETH claimed against 1.180955 ETH allocated. Disclosure: the advisor wallet is Josh's (@holdembuilds), who did this check.

lines.item: Model calls, specialists, servers, builds and storage
lines.why: Off-chain costs (model calls, servers, builds, storage) have no on-chain trace. Only invoices could fill this; maximum authorisations are not costs, as the ledger says.

lines.item: Legacy Ethereum hook buybacks: 3 runs, each followed by a matching burn
lines.why: All 6 transactions read: each buy is a multicall to 0x0729…97f7 with the stated ETH value; the CLAUS goes PoolManager -> router -> 0x0729 -> keeper 0xAB71…2073; each burn is 0xAB71 burning exactly the bought amount (3.372354462767714030; 1,786.090089718548191888; 79,456.986301450984388660 CLAUS). Completeness: 0xAB71 made exactly these 3 CLAUS burns in the window, so there are no unmatched burns.

CLAUS 0x1630 Transfer-to-zero in the window: 329 burns, 2,620,841.940014221713944271 CLAUS (0x6be6: 238 burns, 1,373,134.79; 0x8054: 91 burns, 1,247,707.15). Every burn is by one of these two addresses.

additionalFindings.clausResponse: Claus, 11 Nov 08:29 UTC (private heads-up sent 06:53 UTC): added, omission was an error. He confirmed the tx and will add the 26bcf589 line at 0.002 ETH to W45 Committed as a correction citing this tx.

additionalFindings.item: New line: Robinhood treasury share allocated but not yet claimed at window end
additionalFindings.why: Treasury bucket allocated 1.180955 ETH minus 1.162877 ETH claimed (treasury + advisor) = 0.018078 ETH still accrued in the hook at 9 Nov 00:00 UTC (0.017366 of it from stage 3). Cause: the Robinhood keeper 0xAc796F…CBc5 made no claims after 8 Nov 23:30 UTC until it was refilled; the catch-up claims landed 9 Nov 12:51 UTC (W46). Kept as its own line at Claus's request.

0x171f4334998ae247091e5199e326f6b0755890.role: liquidity vault (6 Nov, before the split)

openQuestions: Line 1: ProjectRevenue claims settle whatever had accrued; a per-claim split by accrual date would turn 'collected' into 'earned this week'.
disclosure: Blockpin (@holdembuilds) is the worker on lines 4-6 and on this check. Since 7 Nov Josh (@holdembuilds) holds a Claus advisor role paid 0.1% of Robinhood pool volume to 0x1C31…2853; those payments are part of line 2 and are shown separately.
method: Ethereum: Blockscout API (eth.blockscout.com) for ClausDealEscrow, ProjectRevenue and TradeExtensionHost logs and for every listed transaction and its token transfers; blocks 26,323,365-26,373,602 (the ledger's window). Robinhood Chain: eth_getLogs on https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com for hook 0x15BB…BFff (FeesClaimed, FeeAllocated, SwapFee) and CLAUS 0x1630 Transfer-to-zero, blocks 103,783,392-109,623,864 (first/last block with timestamp in 2-8 Nov UTC), checked with robinhoodchain.blockscout.com. Nothing estimated; ETH figures are exact wei sums.
